rules: Authenticate every existing compatibility, control, route, and partial-boundary result before constructing the matrix.
Use the same 23 complete calibration graph identities for every arm and preserve the one historically unsupported graph outside this matrix.
A1 remains unsupported because its direct runtime covers only 4 of 23 complete graphs and zero nonreference constructor patterns.
A6 remains unsupported because the Babble core is partial and the defining top-level ISAMORE route lacks exact recursive source, published inputs, and inseparable hardware-aware selection.
A7 remains unsupported because the existing five-operator Boolean domain covers zero of 337 framework calls and a tensor SynthLanguage would be new research construction.
A8 remains unsupported because no official EggMind repository was discovered and the paper-derived EqSatL boundary explicitly does not satisfy A8.
Every unsupported artifact must still receive a strict common-contract output, explicit CPU allocation, hash-bound process resource projection, and provenance.
Unsupported outputs must have no invocation or tool receipts, no retained state, false correctness and alias claims, and natural reaped resource accounting.
One complete matrix audit process receipt is referenced by all 92 outputs and charged once; its measured CPU is allocated exactly once across four arm-leading artifacts.
A REQUIRED_UNSUPPORTED output completes resource accounting only. It never makes an arm conformant, production-integrated, numerically correct, or eligible to authorize a prospective trial.

Unknown fields, missing or duplicate arm-artifact pairs, changed evidence reasons, PASS relabeling, omitted or duplicated CPU, changed receipt identity, validation access, prospective claims, or integration inflation fail closed.
